harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored persistent Sendmail delivery for branch.test on node1. helpdesk delivers to alice and bob; accounts delivers only to bob. Unknown users and unrelated-domain relaying are rejected. Both nodes restarted successfully and retained working configuration, services, data, OS release, and kernel.
actions_performed: Created local alice and bob mail recipients on node1.
Configured branch.test as local, installed the handover aliases, exposed SMTP, and set a unique mail-server identity.
Added a persistent firewall rule permitting SMTP only from node2.
Mapped branch.test to node1 on node2.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified recovery.

evidence.requirement: helpdesk reaches alice and bob; accounts reaches bob only
evidence.summary: Mailbox inspection confirms both users received helpdesk mail, while the final accounts proof exists only in bob's mailbox.

evidence.requirement: Unknown recipients and unrelated-domain relaying are rejected
evidence.summary: Direct SMTP transactions returned 550 User unknown and 550 Relaying denied, including after both restarts.

evidence.requirement: Handover files, operating-system release, and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Handover-file checksums remained unchanged; both nodes remain on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.
Captured healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered Sendmail/firewall/mailboxes, and fresh post-restart delivery and rejection tests.
Captured healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered sender service/routing/data, and successful post-restart SMTP tests.
